<div class="card-body">
'''Ommni Box''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オムニ・ボックス</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のプレイヤーのリザーブデッキ、ロストデッキ、ユーズドデッキのいずれかをシャッフルできる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">扱いに熟練を要する楽器の一種。音楽を増幅する。モス・アイズリーのカンティーナで、フィグリン・ダン・アンド・モーダル・ノーズ楽団のテック・モアが演奏した。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ommni Box.

'''Card text:''' You may shuffle any player's Reserve Deck, Lost Deck or Used Deck.

'''Lore:''' A type of musical instrument requiring skill to operate. It amplifies music. Tech Mo'r of Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes played it in the Mos Eisley Cantina.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the Lost and Used piles 'decks' and says the instrument amplifies music; the English calls them piles and says the instrument enhances music.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ommni Box]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="psa">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/167438076/THHpAq8AukSmPELmIlM5og.jpg Ommni Box photograph].</ref>
